summary: Einride AB (foreign private issuer) files Form 6-K to announce the closing of its business combination with SPAC Legato Merger Corp. III, approved by Legato shareholders on June 4, 2026. Einride's ADSs and warrants begin trading on Nasdaq under ENRD and ENRDW as of June 10, 2026. The transaction valued Einride at a pre-money equity value of approximately $1.35 billion and included an oversubscribed $113 million PIPE financing supported by EQT Ventures and a West Coast asset manager. TD Cowen acted as lead financial and capital markets advisor to Einride; Graubard Miller served as legal counsel to Legato. Post-combination, the combined entity is publicly traded. Watch for liquidity and stock price performance post-listing, as well as any lockup expiration effects.
